prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: full landscape gameplay-view concept revision, NOT production implementation.
Input image 1 is the clean previous scene and the EDIT TARGET: preserve its camera, map orientation/local composition, orange character, merchant/cart, guard/dog, furniture outside the revised room, and cream HUD positions. Input image2 is USER ANNOTATION GUIDANCE: red rectangles indicate areas to consider, they are NOT part of the design. REMOVE ALL red markup in final output.
User direction: the elevated cafeteria wall on RIGHT is good and should be retained. The solitary cell on LEFT must instead become a fully ENCLOSED DARK ROOM WITH A SEALED ROOF so NO INTERIOR IS VISIBLE. Introduce tasteful differences between wall constructions while remaining ONE coherent warm hand-painted grey-green prison style.
Primary revision, exact region: the large left room containing the single thin bed, toilet/sink and vent, immediately left of the selected orange prisoner (the upper big red rectangle in image2). Replace that whole cutaway/open-top room with a solid roofed solitary-cell building in the SAME ground footprint. Full opaque flat roof covering EVERY part of its interior, no bed, toilet, floor or internal object visible. Thick dark grey-green masonry exterior walls, slightly darker charcoal/slate reinforced flat roof with subtle weathered paint and just two or three slab seams. A narrow complete coping/rim neatly seals roof-to-wall edges. Closed solid worn grey-green steel door embedded into its SOUTH/front facade, small shut inspection hatch, dull brass latch, a small discreet plaque '禁闭室'. The roof is SOLID ARCHITECTURE, not a black empty hole or darkened transparent room. No glass, skylight, roof cutaway, open hatch, cross-section or see-through surface. No comfortable interior exposed. A tiny outside ventilation grille is fine on an EXTERIOR side/front wall, never an opening revealing contents.
Keep selected prisoner in the central corridor OUTSIDE the building, fully visible, roof does not cover him or invade the corridor. Keep merchant above, guard/shepherd below and passage width. Keep remaining ordinary dormitory at lower left OPEN/CUTAWAY so its visible simple furnishings contrast with the opaque solitary block.
Cafeteria at right: retain the successful HIGH WALL and embedded open barred entry. Same proper stone jambs, raised wall face and continuous coping, recessed/parked leaf at left, clear walk-through floor gap. The wall face can be slightly warmer/lighter grey-green plaster over a darker block plinth, with tidy pale coping, to differentiate this public area. Do not lower the approved cafeteria wall or replace it with a free-standing iron arch. Keep the compact access reader on reveal and '食堂' label.
WALL FAMILY DIFFERENCES in this one scene:
A solitary: thick, closed, dark masonry + fully sealed muted charcoal roof, heavy readable exterior, no horror.
B cafeteria: taller pale warm-grey/plaster wall, neat coping and sturdy lower stone band, public indoor building, open-top for gameplay visibility.
C ordinary dorm: lower irregular grey-green ashlar wall with slightly chipped warm coping, open cutaway room.
D central corridor boundary: low thinner bevelled stone edging, simple clear outline, airy path.
All share ink color, upper-left diffuse light, gentle paint grain and same construction language. Use architectural thickness and material differences, not neon color coding or excessive textures. Doors connected to walls; visible door dimensions roughly1.4-1.7 times orange character height. Ground thresholds flush. No floating parts, huge independent pillars or wall intersecting a door.
Camera exactly the previous gentle elevated orthographic, north-south/east-west ground axes, no diamond isometric or dramatic perspective. Preserve the entire familiar HUD with paper time card/top-left, three left stacked partner cards, top-right counters/minimap, bottom-left translucent joystick, bottom-right skill/backpack buttons. No new UI, annotations, inset panels, arrows or explanatory labels beyond existing area signs. Chinese text subtle and readable.
Return one polished horizontal full game-scene concept, opaque background, no red rectangles, no Windows chrome. The visual takeaway should be immediate: a closed dark ROOFED solitary building at left, the successful raised cafeteria wall at right, and differing lower wall treatments in the surrounding accessible areas.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: companion architecture MATERIAL / WALL VARIANT concept sheet for this prison game, for review only.
References provide exact warm hand-painted cartoon rendering, grey-green stone, warm pale coping, dark ink outlines, gentle orthographic raised view. Do not recreate UI or the full screenshot.
Create a clean landscape sheet with FOUR equally spaced panels in a2x2 grid on warm cream paper, very faint separators. Title '墙体差异探索'. Each panel shows one small architectural corner/short wall module in the SAME camera and roughly same plan span, with a single tiny simplified orange prisoner silhouette for height comparison. The differences must be clear and useful while all belong to one prison.
TOP LEFT label '禁闭室 · 封闭厚墙': dark grey-green thick masonry facade, charcoal-grey solid concrete roof slab sealing it completely. Show roof plane, coping edge and exterior wall return, a small closed solid door. NO cutaway, NO visible interior, NO black empty pit.
TOP RIGHT label '食堂 · 浅色高墙': taller pale warm-grey plaster face on darker grey-green masonry plinth, broad tidy pale coping, an embedded side reveal, no independent metal gate frame. Height around1.5 times small prisoner.
BOTTOM LEFT label '寝室 · 低石墙': lower coarse grey-green ashlar, a few broad block joints, chipped warm coping, cutaway/open construction, low enough to see furnishing area (no furnishings required).
BOTTOM RIGHT label '走廊 · 矮边墙': low slender stone edging/parapet, simple beveled top, restrained darker front face, airy and clear.
Keep color saturation quiet; warm top highlights, sparse wear, ink outlines, subtle brush texture. All wall front horizontal edges screen-horizontal and pillars screen-vertical, gently elevated orthographic, not diamond isometric. Do not add extra architecture styles, horror, vegetation, dramatic shadow, neon, unnecessary labels or any gameplay HUD. Chinese headings only; no dimensional numbers or pseudo production measurements. Full opaque paper background. This is a concept comparison, not sprite atlas.
